breakdown.description: Method section specifies dt=0.001 with 600 steps, which does not match the requested final time T=0.5.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains dt=0.001 with 600 steps, which gives a final time of 0.6, not 0.5. The ground truth corrects this to 500 steps (dt=0.001 × 500 = 0.5). The agent repeated the original error and even incorrectly claimed that 600 steps would reach T=0.5.
